scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @laita/contracts && npm run build --workspace @laita/runtime && npm run build --workspace @laita/policy && npm run build --workspace @laita/persistence && npm run build --workspace @laita/providers && npm run build --workspace @laita/orchestration && npm run build --workspace @laita/course-grounding && npm run typecheck --workspaces

scripts.format:write: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.base.json .prettierrc.json apps packages scripts/ci/*.test.mjs scripts/ci/*workspace*.mjs scripts/ci/check-runtime-engines.mjs scripts/ci/check-public-boundary.mjs scripts/smoke-workspace.mjs scripts/test-public-course-sources.mjs ops/macos/*.mjs scripts/test-reference-edge.mjs

scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @laita/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @laita/web
scripts.course-sources:refresh: npm run build --workspace @laita/contracts && npm run build --workspace @laita/runtime && npm run build --workspace @laita/course-grounding && npm run refresh --workspace @laita/course-grounding --
